note: Normalised by scripts/blender/prepare_devices.py (metres, screen named "screen" with 0..1 UVs, no Draco, frame/glass materials polished). Re-run it on the source files to rebuild. pnpm assets:sync --family 3d downloads each source (downloadedFrom, verified by sourceSha256) into .cache/assets/3d/inputs as sourceFile and runs that script; sha256 is the committed reference output, which Blender does not reproduce byte for byte.
